final_answer: Kestrel does not offer self-hosted, on-premises, single-tenant, or customer-VPC deployment options [2]. Kestrel Insight is exclusively multi-tenant SaaS with logical isolation hosted on AWS [1][2]. Because dedicated and on-premises installations are not supported, there is no provisioning option or timeline available for them [2].
question: Our regulated business unit cannot use multi-tenant SaaS. Please describe the self-hosted or on-premises deployment options available for regulated customers, including any private-cloud or customer-VPC installation, and the timeline to provision one.
